name: Glaucous-Spandrel
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near a subterranean ocean.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
At the monolithic structures of unknown origin, the toolmarks are still half-finished. Whatever called everyone away did not give them time to say goodbye.
Archaeologists and weapons engineers circle the same sites, quoting each other's permits with disgust. The ruins tolerate both, so far.
